images.alt: Epafras vertelt over de liefde — Kolossenzen 1:8; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. Colossians 1:7–8: Epaphras has told Paul about the Colossian believers’ love in the Spirit. Exactly two adult men, an ordinary travelling Epaphras seated with Paul in a modest first-century room. Epaphras speaks warmly and Paul listens with gratitude, simple open hands and a small travel bag set aside. No crowd from Colossae meeting Paul, no invented readable letter or exact location. Modest opaque robes, natural two arms each; no claim to exact portraits.

images.alt: Epafras bidt voor de gemeenten — Kolossenzen 4:12; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. Colossians 4:12–13 describes Epaphras persistently praying for the believers in Colossae, Laodicea and Hierapolis, to stand mature in God’s will. One adult Epaphras prays earnestly alone in a simple first-century household room, fully covering plain robes, exactly two arms with hands gently clasped. Quiet concentration, not a literal wrestling match. No God portrait, physical combat, visible supernatural body or readable writing. A dignified illustration of the named person’s prayer, not an anonymous group meal.
